name: brandwell
description: BrandWell for Claude Code: BrandWell skills and MCP server, one plugin per product. Install the products you use.

plugins.name: brandwell-visibility
plugins.description: BrandWell Visibility skills and MCP tools: AI and search visibility, keyword research, site audits, competitors, AI citations and local search. Signs in through your browser.

plugins.name: brandwell-rankwell
plugins.description: BrandWell RankWell skills and MCP tools: plan what to write next, then create, refine and publish briefs and articles. Signs in through your browser.

plugins.name: brandwell-link-builder
plugins.description: BrandWell Link Builder skills and MCP tools: set up and review link campaigns and find link and citation prospects. Signs in through your browser.

plugins.name: brandwell-marketpulse
plugins.description: BrandWell MarketPulse skills and MCP tools: find the people researching what you sell, manage your ICP, topics and Intent Scans, and share Intent Scans. Signs in through your browser.

plugins.name: brandwell-outreach
plugins.description: BrandWell Outreach skills and MCP tools: email campaigns, feeds and contacts, and cold emails that get replies. Signs in through your browser.

plugins.name: brandwell-direct-mail
plugins.description: BrandWell Direct Mail skills and MCP tools: draft, schedule and run postcard campaigns. Signs in through your browser.

plugins.name: brandwell-trafficid
plugins.description: BrandWell TrafficID skills and MCP tools: identified website visitors, their detail and form completions. Signs in through your browser.

plugins.name: brandwell-socialstreams
plugins.description: BrandWell SocialStreams skills and MCP tools: social posts, hiring signals and creators found for your project. Signs in through your browser.

plugins.name: brandwell-lead-database
plugins.description: BrandWell Lead Database skills and MCP tools: search people and companies, build audiences, enrich records with data tools and waterfalls, all paid from your Workflow Wallet. Signs in through your browser.

plugins.name: brandwell-account
plugins.description: BrandWell usage and plans skills and MCP tools: account usage, Workflow Wallet charges, platform plans, connected agents and sync. Signs in through your browser.

plugins.name: brandwell-automations
plugins.description: BrandWell Automations skills and MCP tools: turn a sentence into an automation, then test, run, pause or resume it. What an automation can do follows the other products in your plan. Signs in through your browser.
